# teams agent blueprint permissions list

List a blueprint's inheritable permissions (scopes every agent identity created from it auto-receives)

## Usage

```
teams agent blueprint permissions list <blueprintId> [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `blueprintId` | Agent blueprint (application) ID | Yes |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
